correctness.rationale: The vector model K[X]/(X^5-1) yields f*g=f(X^{-1})g(X^2); in the truncated logarithm coordinate, substitutions are exactly -w and 2w. Expansion of [f,g] gives 3p01,3p02,4(p03+p12),4p13. The sole 4-vector Pluecker relation is necessary and sufficient for a decomposable bivector, with rank-two reconstruction over every characteristic-five field. When z1=0 it reduces to u^2-su+bd=0 with discriminant z3^2-2z2z4. The width follows by splitting the first coordinate into 1 and -1, while field nonsquares force width two; finite-field counting multiplies q(q-1) choices by (q-1)/2 nonsquares. Direct finite computations reproduce all pairs over F5 and the F25 discriminant census; none is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise image of the commutator map is a natural invariant of the explicitly studied quandle ring, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The new criterion explains the previously mysterious known count of 40 over F5, resolves commutator length for every vector over any characteristic-five coefficient field, determines the full extension-field distribution, and detects the exact field-theoretic obstruction to width one. Its Klein-quadric geometry supplies a reusable structural method beyond finite brute-force enumeration.
